title: GST 114 ( UNN ) : CHAPTER FIVE ( THE SENTENCE )
subject: GST 114

questions.question: A sentence is a group of words that expresses which of the following?
questions.explanation: A sentence is a group of words that expresses a complete thought or idea.

questions.question: Which element explains the doer of an action in a sentence?
questions.explanation: The subject explains the doer or performer of an action in a sentence.

questions.question: Which sentence element discusses or explains the subject?
questions.explanation: The predicate discusses or explains the subject in a sentence.

questions.question: A simple sentence contains how many finite verbs?
questions.explanation: A simple sentence has only one finite verb and expresses one idea.

questions.question: Which sentence type comprises an independent clause and a subordinate clause?
questions.explanation: A complex sentence comprises an independent clause and one or more subordinate clauses.

questions.question: A compound sentence consists of how many independent clauses?
questions.explanation: A compound sentence consists of two independent clauses.

questions.question: Which sentence type is made up of two independent clauses and one or more subordinate clauses?
questions.explanation: A compound-complex sentence is made up of two independent clauses and one or more subordinate clauses.

questions.question: A multiple sentence consists of how many independent clauses?
questions.explanation: A multiple sentence consists of three or more independent clauses.

questions.question: Which sentence type contains three or more main clauses and one or more subordinate clauses?
questions.explanation: A multiple-complex sentence comprises three or more main clauses and one or more subordinate clauses.

questions.question: Which sentence type has only one clause and expresses one idea?
questions.explanation: A simple sentence has only one finite verb and expresses one idea.

questions.question: Which sentence type contains two independent clauses joined by a coordinating conjunction?
questions.explanation: A compound sentence consists of two independent clauses joined by a coordinating conjunction.

questions.question: Which sentence type contains one main clause and one or more dependent clauses?
questions.explanation: A complex sentence consists of one independent clause and one or more dependent clauses.

questions.question: Which sentence type contains more than two independent clauses without a dependent clause?
questions.explanation: A multiple sentence consists of three or more independent clauses without a dependent clause.

questions.question: Which sentence type expresses opinions, suggestions, or feelings?
questions.explanation: Statements express opinions, suggestions, feelings, or ideas.

questions.question: Which sentence type seeks answers and is interrogative in nature?
questions.explanation: Questions are interrogative in nature and seek answers.

questions.question: Which sentence type requires the addressee to comply?
questions.explanation: Commands require the addressee to comply and are imperative in nature.

questions.question: Which sentence type expresses sudden emotions or surprises?
questions.explanation: Exclamations express sudden emotions, surprises, or pains.

questions.question: Which question type expects a simple yes or no answer?
questions.explanation: Yes-No questions expect a one-word answer of yes or no.

questions.question: Which question type demands explanations or information?
questions.explanation: WH-questions demand explanations or information rather than a simple yes or no.

questions.question: Which question type contains two or more options joined by or?
questions.explanation: Alternative questions contain two or more options joined by the word or.

questions.question: Which question type often uses interrogative words like who or what?
questions.explanation: WH-questions are formed with interrogative words such as who, whose, or what.

questions.question: Which sentence type is usually declarative with subjects coming before verbs?
questions.explanation: Statements are usually declarative and their subjects always come before the verbs.

questions.question: Which sentence type may not necessarily have a graphically represented subject?
questions.explanation: A command may not have a subject but contains an imperative finite verb.

questions.question: Which functional units form the elements of a sentence?
questions.explanation: The five functional units of a sentence are subject, verb, complement, object, and adverbial (SVOCA).

questions.question: Which element adds information about the subject or object?
questions.explanation: A complement adds additional information about a subject or object.

questions.question: Which element describes the action performed and also shows time and place?
questions.explanation: An adverbial describes the action performed and also shows time and place of actions.

questions.question: Which element receives the action of the verb?
questions.explanation: The object is the action of a subject or a direct object can affect an indirect object.

questions.question: Which element is the central element of a predicate?
questions.explanation: The verb is the central element of a predicate.

questions.question: Which element functions as an adverb or adjective in a sentence?
questions.explanation: An adverbial functions as an adverb or adjective in a sentence.

questions.question: Which element explains the doer or performer of an action?
questions.explanation: The subject explains the doer or performer of an action in a sentence.

questions.question: Which pattern is the shortest way a simple sentence can be constructed?
questions.explanation: The SV pattern is the shortest way a simple sentence can be constructed.

questions.question: Which sentence pattern consists of subject, verb, and adverbial?
questions.explanation: The SVA pattern consists of subject, verb, and adverbial.

questions.question: Which sentence pattern consists of subject, verb, and complement?
questions.explanation: The SVC pattern consists of subject, verb, and complement.

questions.question: Which sentence pattern is made up of subject, verb, and object?
questions.explanation: The SVO pattern is made up of subject, verb, and object.

questions.question: Which sentence pattern consists of subject, verb, direct object, and indirect object?
questions.explanation: The SVOO pattern consists of subject, verb, direct object, and indirect object.

questions.question: Which sentence pattern consists of subject, verb, object, and complement?
questions.explanation: The SVOC pattern consists of subject, verb, object, and complement.

questions.question: Which sentence pattern consists of subject, verb, direct object, indirect object, and adverbial?
questions.explanation: The SVOOA pattern consists of subject, verb, direct object, indirect object, and adverbial.

questions.question: Which sentence pattern consists of subject, verb, direct object, and adverbial?
questions.explanation: The SVOA pattern consists of subject, verb, direct object, and adverbial.

questions.question: Which pattern uses only two elements: subject and verb?
questions.explanation: The SV pattern uses only two elements: subject and verb.

questions.question: Which pattern uses a direct object and an indirect object?
questions.explanation: The SVOO pattern uses a direct object and an indirect object.

questions.question: Which pattern contains a complement?
questions.explanation: The SVOC pattern contains a complement.

questions.question: Which pattern contains an adverbial?
questions.explanation: The SVA pattern contains an adverbial.

questions.question: Which pattern is exemplified by He bought a car for his father?
questions.explanation: He bought a car for his father exemplifies the SVOO pattern.

questions.question: Which pattern is exemplified by The chairman gave the students a book yesterday?
questions.explanation: The chairman gave the students a book yesterday exemplifies the SVOOA pattern.

questions.question: Which pattern is exemplified by They elected her the senior prefect yesterday?
questions.explanation: They elected her the senior prefect yesterday exemplifies the SVOA pattern.

questions.question: How many sentence patterns are identified in English by Oguntuga et al?
questions.explanation: Oguntuga et al. identify nine sentence patterns in English.

questions.question: Which sentence pattern consists of subject, verb, and complement?
questions.explanation: The SVC pattern consists of subject, verb, and complement.

questions.question: Which sentence pattern contains both a direct object and an adverbial?
questions.explanation: The SVOA pattern contains both a direct object and an adverbial.

questions.question: Which sentence pattern contains an indirect object?
questions.explanation: The SVOO pattern contains an indirect object.

questions.question: Which sentence pattern contains an object complement?
questions.explanation: The SVOC pattern contains an object complement.
